smallshipsheraldry.help.title: Heraldry Table guide
smallshipsheraldry.help.layout: Use the Paint, Parts, and View tabs at the top left. The side panels change with the selected mode; the ship preview stays in the centre.
smallshipsheraldry.help.paint: Paint: tools and their settings are on the left; colour controls or selection actions are on the right. Drag Selection over a sail, then use Ctrl+C/X/V. Move a pasted fragment with the mouse or arrow keys and apply it with Enter.
smallshipsheraldry.help.parts: Parts: sail parts are listed on the left. Selection, visibility, isolate, fill, and clear actions are on the right. Ctrl/Shift select several parts.
smallshipsheraldry.help.view: View: grid, camera presets, and reset are on the left. RMB rotates, Shift+RMB or MMB pans, and the wheel zooms.
smallshipsheraldry.help.navigation: Below the preview, the outer arrows change ship type and the S arrows change sail stage. The table keeps a separate draft for each ship type.
smallshipsheraldry.help.controls: Paint on the sail with LMB. Alt+LMB picks the colour under the cursor. Ctrl+Z undoes an action; Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z restores it. Each tool's tooltip shows its shortcut.
smallshipsheraldry.help.selection: Selection (M): hold LMB and drag an area over the sail. Ctrl+C copies it, Ctrl+X cuts it, and Ctrl+V previews a paste. Drag the fragment or move it with the arrow keys; hold Shift to move 8 pixels at a time. Enter confirms the paste; Del erases selected pixels. Esc cancels the paste or clears the selection. Press Esc again to close the editor.
smallshipsheraldry.help.library: Library at the lower left keeps patterns between worlds and servers. Drop .sshpattern files into the editor or place them in the opened folder.
smallshipsheraldry.help.workflow: At the lower right, insert paper and press Print. Sneak and use the pattern on a matching ship; sneak and use shears to remove it.
smallshipsheraldry.help.apply: Hold a printed pattern, hold the sneak key (Shift by default), and right-click a ship. The ship type must match the one shown in the pattern's tooltip. If another pattern is already installed, you will get it back.
